comment: Deliberate exceptions to MODULE_SPEC.md §4.2 (Backend Module Call Boundary, In-Process First). App Store reaches sdkwork-drive and sdkwork-search IN-PROCESS by default: crates/sdkwork-appstore-service-host/src/integrations/{drive,search}_inprocess.rs call the sibling modules' service/repository crates over the shared PostgreSQL, and no sibling endpoint variable is read unless a deployment explicitly opts in. The entries below are the ONLY remaining split-deployment paths. Each is gated behind APPSTORE_INTEGRATION_MODE=http, is built during startup (so a missing endpoint or service credential aborts the boot instead of failing the first business request), and is never constructed by a deployment that leaves the mode unset. Removing them would delete the supported real-split-deployment topology, which §4.2.3 records as an allowed exception.

allow.reason: Opt-in split deployment only. APPSTORE_INTEGRATION_MODE=http selects this adapter; the default is integrations::drive_inprocess over sdkwork-drive-workspace-service/sdkwork-drive-object-runtime. from_env() fails at startup when APPSTORE_DRIVE_BASE_URL is missing, so it can never be reached by accident. This is the same shape recorded for sdkwork-order -> account in MODULE_SPEC.md §4.2.6.

Opt-in split deployment only. Requires APPSTORE_INTEGRATION_MODE=http AND APPSTORE_SEARCH_ENABLED=1; the default is integrations::search_inprocess over sdkwork-search-provider-postgresql, and an unset deployment leaves search federation off entirely. from_env() fails at startup when APPSTORE_SEARCH_BASE_URL is missing.

Opt-in split deployment only. Requires APPSTORE_INTEGRATION_MODE=http AND APPSTORE_SEARCH_PROJECTION_ENABLED=1; the default is integrations::search_inprocess over sdkwork-search-provider-postgresql. from_env() fails at startup when APPSTORE_SEARCH_BACKEND_BASE_URL or APPSTORE_SEARCH_INDEX_ID is missing. The only consumer is the listing publish/unpublish projection, which already treats projection failure as a logged warning.

Explicit HTTP opt-in, default is in-process, startup-validated. File-scoped entry for the second detection mode: this is the Drive upload-session HTTP client, used only by DriveHttpAdapter (drive_http_adapter.rs), which APPSTORE_INTEGRATION_MODE=http selects and which fails at startup without APPSTORE_DRIVE_BASE_URL. It is not a leftover upload path: the default in-process Drive port already uploads through DriveUploaderService::upload_bytes (prepare -> object write -> part mark -> completion), so no default deployment can reach this file.

Remix deliberately reads sdkwork-deploy over HTTP, and there is no in-process alternative to opt out of: deploy owns the application source pointer and re-derives source readiness (repository validation, artifact liveness) on every read, and this repository consumes no deploy service crate. The read is a projection of deploy-owned coordinates, not a business transaction, so the order->account failure mode in MODULE_SPEC.md §4.2.6 (a write committed before a failed cross-module call) cannot occur. The endpoint is resolved per request instead of at boot, and a missing APPSTORE_DEPLOY_BASE_URL answers 503 naming that exact variable rather than fabricating a download. `deploy` is not part of the checker's sibling-module vocabulary, so this entry is documentation for review rather than a checker suppression.
